_comment: Design morphology. This is the knob that decides whether a plan reads as contour agriculture or as consolidated blocks. It does not change what is legal - the Forest Code obligation is identical either way - only the shape the compliance takes.

linearity._meaning: 0.0 = grow compact bodies outward from existing vegetation. 1.0 = lay strips along the land's contours, stream margins and field edges. Values in between mix the two, which is usually what a real farm wants: blocks where there is already forest to build onto, lines across the open slopes.
linearity._per_archetype_note: corridor_network stays blocky on purpose - a habitat corridor wants width, not a hedgerow. productive_mosaic goes linear because alley cropping and windbreaks are what make agroforestry driveable.

strips._meaning: Geometry of a contour strip. Widths are snapped up to a whole number of machine passes using the active machinery profile, so a strip never wastes half a boom.
strips._contour_interval_note: Vertical spacing between candidate contour lines. Tighter interval = more, closer strips. 10-15 m suits the gentle chapada slopes of Mato Grosso; drop to 5 m on steeper ground.
strips._target_width_note: Strip width as a multiple of the implement width. 2 passes of a 36 m boom = 72 m, wide enough to count as restoration rather than a hedgerow. Set to 1 for single-pass strips.
strips._min_length_note: Shorter strips are not worth the turns. Raise this for bigger machinery.
strips._resolution_note: The analysis grid is 10 m, so these widths are real: a 20 m field-edge band is two cells and holds its shape, where on the old 60 m grid anything under ~120 m rounded away. Widths are still snapped up to whole implement passes, so the geometry stays drivable.

blobs._grow_note: When true, blob moves seed preferentially on blocks already touching native vegetation, so new area lands against old rather than starting isolated patches.

drivability._meaning: Enforced when the design lines are built, not priced afterwards. A contour that doubles back tighter than the machine can turn is split, and the offcuts below min_strip_length_m are discarded. Every strip the sampler can propose is therefore already drivable.
